# How and for Whom Using Generative AI Affects Creativity: A Field Experiment

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Shuhua Sun, Zhuyi Angelina Li, Maw-Der Foo, Jing Zhou  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Applied Psychology  
**DOI:** [10.1037/apl0001274](https://doi.org/10.1037/apl0001274)

**Keywords:** generative AI, creativity, field experiment, cognitive approach, employee performance

## Abstract

A field experiment examining how generative AI usage affects employee creativity, finding that the creative benefits of generative AI depend on individuals' cognitive approaches. Selected as an APA Editor's Choice article for December 2025.
